view: Monday's +31.5% news gap turned the 11-20 breakdown into a confirmed trap. Price reclaimed 140.76, the 2023 trendline, 148.80, 154.53 and fib 0.65 (161.97) all on the first close, so the 200W SMA / fib 0.5 low at 124.50 is now a credible swing low. But the structure is repaired only to the old L1 zone: price is still below the 100W SMA (175.25), the 200D SMA (203.24) and the daily SMA20/50. Monday faded from its 171.50 high and closed below its open, and a 125.53-156.93 gap sits unfilled below. I lean modestly up on the 2-week view and on both quarters, and keep wide tails because the daily ATR is 8%.

QUESTION ANSWERED — signs before 11-23 (11-22 readings and run) that POINTED to a sharp rebound: (1) completed weekly RSI 25.01, the lowest since 2023, with weekly RSI7 11.78 and Stoch RSI 0/0; (2) daily RSI14 15.05 / RSI7 7.86 / Stoch RSI 0/0 and price 38.3% below the 200D SMA and 20.8% below SMA10, an extreme stretch that usually snaps back; (3) the low (124.50) landed on a four-way confluence: 200W SMA 124.14, log fib 0.786 124.98, linear fib 0.5 127.09, and it never closed below the 200W; (4) climactic volume (633M, 3.9x the 60-day average; the week 2.05B) after 7 straight weekly declines and the worst week since 2008; (5) the 4H Cipher B WT +5.04 positive divergence at the low; (6) the 2w-drop ≤-15% conditional (n=4: 2w 50/50/0, 13w 100% up, median +32.1%) and the weekly RSI ≤36 conditional (13w 69% up).

Signs that did NOT point to it: (1) the 11-20 daily and weekly bars closed 0.8% / 1.03 above their lows with no rejection wick, a full-body information-shock bar; (2) weekly MACD histogram widening (-10.11) and daily MACD below signal; (3) the BBPCT daily bottom triangles of Nov 10-13 had already failed; (4) trend down on 1W/1D/4H with a broken trendline and a fresh gap overhead. Bottom line: the technicals said 'stretched, at major support, high variance' (I widened both tails to 35/29/36). They could not give the direction or the size. The +31.5% came from a binary news catalyst (CEO reinstatement), and a ≥+15% day is a 0.32%-of-days event. The chart identified where a reversal would most likely start, not that one would happen.

Self-score of the 11-22 run: three of my listed triggers fired on the first session. 'Daily close back above 140.76 by 11-25' (I said this_quarter up above 45), 'close above 131.81' and 'close above 145.71' were all hit on the 11-23 close. The old 2w up bucket (>131.81) is in the money if price holds into 12-04. Lessons-log candidates: (a) I labelled the 148.80 break CONFIRMED after 2 closes, but the trap clock runs 3 closes and it reclaimed on the 3rd, so do not declare a break confirmed before the clock ends; (b) a completed-bar weekly RSI under 30 at a multi-anchor confluence on climactic volume is a high-variance setup: weight the up tail at least equal to the down tail.
